headline: Modular software pipelines unify single-cell, spatial, bulk and multi-omics analysis
label: Sequencing Data Analysis Tools
summary: Recent releases pair reproducible workflow frameworks with GPU acceleration and LLM-assisted annotation for omics data.
synthesis: The dominant thread is software that packages omics analysis into reproducible, modular, or interoperable frameworks. NNclinSSOAP orchestrates single-cell and Xenium spatial transcriptomics in a GxP-ready Nextflow pipeline, while BULLKpy applies scverse-inspired AnnData design to bulk RNA-seq and multi-omics, and AstraKit unifies variant interpretation, multi-omics integration, and drug-screen matching in KNIME. EMTscore provides R-based gene set scoring across EMT pathways in single-cell or bulk data. What is new is the coupling of constrained language models to annotation: CytoAnalyst pairs Llama prompting with ontology and marker constraints for semi-automatic cell type annotation, alongside QC. SPAC contributes GPU acceleration for single-cell spatial analysis of a 2.6-million-cell multiplex dataset. Two Shiny applications, Age effect explorer and MRDviz, instead emphasize interactive visualization of precomputed or simulated results rather than pipeline construction.
